display_name: Reconcile operator managed-session rows against positive bridge liveness
description: R3-U1's explicit operator-presence reconciliation and one-time backfill surface. It enumerates non-terminal managed_session rows with host='operator', evaluates each through the shared binding_is_live-based primitive, and returns one classification per row: live (untouched), dead (proposes lifecycle_state -> terminated), or indeterminate (held, never killed). It does not inspect inactivity, report_by, output volume, or work age: an operator seat may be idle for days while its bridge polls and remains live. dry_run defaults to true, so an omitted argument classifies and reports only. Only dry_run=false applies proposed terminal transitions, after review. This verb is caller-driven and one-time; it does not schedule an ongoing sweep. R3's later sweeper consumes the same library primitive for its operator-presence branch.
embedding_description: Safe-by-default operator-session liveness backfill: omitted dry_run means classify and report only; pass dry_run=false to apply. Uses bridge polling presence, not inactivity: live or indeterminate rows stay untouched; only a provably dead binding becomes terminated.

dry_run.description: True = classify and report only; pass false to act.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: dry_run: whether this call only reported or also applied. classifications: every non-terminal operator managed_session row, each with agent_instance_id, lifecycle_state, classification, detail, and proposed_to_state. applied: the agent_instance_id values actually transitioned to terminated (empty for dry runs, live rows, and held indeterminate rows).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the counts of dead/proposed, live/untouched, indeterminate/held, and applied. Preserve the row-by-row dry-run output when seeking approval for the one-time backfill. Never describe a live operator row as stale merely because it has been idle; positive bridge liveness is decisive for this row class.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Omit dry_run (the default is true) to obtain a row-by-row report. If any classification is indeterminate, hold that row and investigate the liveness evidence; do not call dry_run=false as a way to force it terminal. After an approved dry run, call dry_run=false once; subsequent calls are idempotent because terminal rows are outside the input set.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads managed_session through StateManagementInterface and live bridge bindings through the peer registry. Apply mode writes only legal managed_session -> terminated lifecycle transitions through StateManagementInterface and records the normal transition audit row.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: state_service_unavailable means the managed-session ledger is unavailable. liveness_services_unavailable means the peer registry or bridge manager is not bound, so no liveness conclusion was made. operator_liveness_reconciliation_failed means the operation aborted loudly rather than silently treating a read failure as death.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For unavailable services, restore the messaging bridge/state binding and retry with dry_run omitted. For a failed reconciliation, inspect the returned exception and retry the dry run; do not infer that an absent result means there were no candidate rows.
